opening.argument: The call is presented as an investigation of a fake technical-support line, not an endorsement of its services. The creators call the number and test its infection claim against a newly installed, clean virtual machine. The person answering offers computer and network cleanup for $149.99, but the creators' stated purpose is to protect people who might fall for such calls. Their advice to viewers is direct: if they receive a similar call, hang up. The record shows a cautionary demonstration of the purported operation, not promotion of the paid cleanup.
